summary: Iteration 4 PASSED. Backend: 69/69 pytest (updated pre-auth suites to JWT + 2 new suites: test_auth.py, test_media_alerts.py). Verified: signup (201 CITIZEN, 409 dup, 422 short password), login per role + 401 wrong password, /auth/me, 401 on all protected routes without token, citizen 403 guards (approve-dispatch/alerts/analytics/audit/responders/assignments), citizen incident scoping (reported_by filter + 403 on foreign incident), upload (image-only 400, 8MB 413, 401 unauth), /api/files via ?token= AND Authorization header (401 without, 404 unknown), SOS media_paths ownership filtering (foreign media dropped), alerts publish/list/deactivate + validation, extended analytics fields, WS ping/pong heartbeat + alert.published broadcast, LLM triage openai/gpt-5.6-terra <26s. Frontend (390x844): auth screen with 4 autofill chips, wrong-password inline error, session persists across reload, citizen SOS with gallery photo (file chooser -> upload -> preview -> remove -> re-attach -> confirm -> StatusCard + media-thumb served via ?token= 200), citizen UI hides operator controls, operator Command Center (analytics-panel with all extended stats + bars, Leaflet/Esri map 8 tiles + incident marker, media thumb + provider label in review panel, alert composer publishes, APPROVE DISPATCH), responder full lifecycle ACCEPTED->EN_ROUTE->ON_SCENE->COMPLETED with responder-map (2 markers), alerts-strip realtime push WITHOUT refresh verified on responder (WS), offline outbox (queued banner -> auto-flush on reconnect -> StatusCard), connection-pill flips to RECONNECTING in 1s on offline (iter-3 gap FIXED), tampered-token -> 401 -> auto-logout to auth screen, signup/logout/admin flows. ONE bug found AND FIXED: 422 validation errors rendered as '[object Object]' in UI (crisis-api.ts request() assumed detail is string; FastAPI returns array for 422) - now surfaces 'String should have at least 12 characters'.

minor.issue: WebSocket endpoint is unauthenticated (accepts any connection and broadcasts all incident/alert events to anonymous listeners). Acceptable for demo, but incident.created payloads leak incident IDs to unauthenticated WS clients while the REST API requires JWT.
Public unauthenticated full-data wipe (gated only by CRISISOS_DEMO_MODE=true). Fine for demo, but must be disabled in any shared/production deployment.

App behavior correct in all three.

One earlier script run mistook the empty state for a StatusCard after its confirm click was correctly ignored while photo upload was in-flight (disabled Pressable working as designed).

Run pytest with -o addopts='' (serial) from /app/backend - conftest.py provides api_client/tokens/auth fixtures; BASE_URL auto-reads frontend/.env. rca_of_issue: BUG (fixed): 422 errors showed '[object Object]'. Repro: signup with password 'short' -> server 422 -> UI renders '[object Object]'. RCA: crisis-api.ts request() did 'new Error(body.detail ?? ...)' but FastAPI returns detail as an ARRAY of {loc,msg,type} for Pydantic 422s; Array->Error.message stringifies to '[object Object]'. Fix: map array details to joined msg strings ('String should have at least 12 characters'). Verified post-fix. NO other app bugs found this iteration.
